summary: Contestants apply payroll principles to calculate earnings, process withholdings, and record payroll transactions using automated systems. The event requires compliance with GAAP, tax regulations, and current laws. Participants complete tasks such as calculating payroll, preparing reports, and maintaining accurate records.
time_limits: no more than ten (10) minutes for orientation
no more than sixty (60) minutes for testing
no more than ten (10) minutes for wrap-up
what_to_bring: Published and/or unpublished non-electronic written reference materials
Cordless calculator: Electronic devices will be monitored according to ACT standards. See NLC Calculator Guidelines. Contestants who violate this rule will be disqualified.
NOTE: Circular E, Employer’s Tax Guide (Publication 15), is recommended as a resource.
competencies: Apply GAAP and relevant tax principles to calculate, record, and report payroll transactions and income tax obligations in compliance with current laws and ethical standards
Accurately complete onboarding forms and explain statutory and voluntary payroll withholdings and deductions to ensure compliance and transparency
Calculate and verify employee earnings across diverse pay structures, including hourly, salary, overtime, commission, piece-rate, and blended compensation models
Create, maintain, and secure accurate employee earnings records using digital payroll systems, ensuring data integrity, confidentiality, and compliance with legal requirements
Calculate employer payroll tax liabilities and employer-paid benefits in compliance with current regulations
Prepare payroll reports and analyze IRS payroll tax forms, applying federal tax regulations to ensure compliance with current guidelines
Identify and apply current federal, state, and local laws and regulations governing payroll procedures
Record and post payroll transactions in accounting systems to ensure accurate financial reporting
Generate payroll disbursements, prepare tax deposits, and maintain payroll registers using automated payroll systems
judging_notes: AI Policy Level 1 No AI Allowed
No equipment, supplies, or materials other than those specified for an event will be allowed in the testing area

Previous Business Professionals of America tests and/or sample tests or facsimiles (handwritten, photocopied or keyed) may not be taken into the testing area. Violation of this rule will result in disqualification.
eligibility_notes: Any secondary or postsecondary division contestant may enter this application event.
